descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: second tab / stale chart.

Suggestion B10 · known · not counted as a bug (was S1): Our own extended check (not stated in the UAT or a ticket AC): No TFA-92582 AC or UAT TC-04 step involves a second open tab; nearest is UAT TC-25 Expected Result 2 (owned by not-ready TFA-94704 / TFA-94513)

If the chart is open in another tab, that tab's autosave or Save & Extract overwrites the text Quick Dictation placed in the encounter

Tickets: TFA-92582 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev

Note: The 'data loss' #1 from this morning's dev report

Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S16 Chart open in a stale tab while boxes are placed: neither its autosave nor its Save & Extract erases the placed text

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 3; TFA-92582 steps 2-3)
  • U7 Assigning does not create tasks, record medication events, or generate a note. Those happen only when the physician opens that patient's Encounter tab and taps Save & Extract. (UAT TC-04; TFA-92582 AC 7)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given QA Hosp Patel (415) with encounter note 'Cross-cover: febrile overnight.'; tab 1 on Patel's Encounter tab

When In tab 2 place 'Bed 415, afebrile since 4 am.' with Link; in tab 1 (no reload) replace the notes with what tab 1 shows plus ' Seen at bedside.', wait 3 s, reload. Then in tab 2 place 'Bed 415. Recheck BMP in the morning.' with Link; in tab 1 (no reload) tap Save & Extract, reload

Then Patel's note holds the old note, both placed boxes and the words typed in tab 1; Save & Extract in the stale tab does not erase the second box (or the app visibly refuses to save stale text)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: cp2 mustContain 'Cross-cover: febrile overnight.', 'Bed 415, afebrile since 4 am.', 'Seen at bedside.' (U2: appended text stays on the note). cp3 mustContain 'Cross-cover: febrile overnight.', 'Seen at bedside.', 'Bed 415. Recheck BMP in the morning.' (U2; U7: Save & Extract works from the chart, it must not wipe what was placed). …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92582 ready for qa

If a patient's chart is left open in another tab while Quick Dictation boxes are assigned to that patient, that tab's autosave or Save & Extract wipes the assigned text from the encounter note.

Evidence: dev U30 (ledger #30). Already dev report §2 #1 (data loss): the backend encounterNotes ends with only tab 1's text. Linking without a stale tab works (U19).

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/newspec-c.
